cases.requirement: Before execution, select at most three already-public O commits and paths whose later main versions differ; bind each expected historical blob and full byte or canonical digest, including at least one retained negative or unknown record if a valid case is available.
Show that each historical identity is reported separately from the current main path/blob and that no historical result is represented as a new current-byte assertion.
Use one predeclared syntactically valid but nonresolving commit identifier and require an explicit nonzero or not-found outcome; never represent it as verified, retained, or unknown-success.
Exercise the unchanged current binding validator on one valid current object and one malformed current digest so historical lookup cannot weaken current validation.

effect_rules: Use only the fetched O repository and read-only Git or GitHub source observations for historical measurement; do not rewrite, prune, force-push, fetch secrets, or modify remote history.
Precommit selected identities, expected outcomes, rubric, command set, and script digest before the first measurement; keep the first failure and do not substitute convenient cases afterward.
Historical object lookup and current canonical validation remain separate mechanisms and separately reported claims.
Do not activate, edit, or route the historical-reference Candidate; this unit does not run a matched baseline-versus-overlay semantic comparison.
Publish only through an isolated branch, unchanged exact-head protected CI, expected-head merge, and exact main readback.
protocol.pass_rule: PASS only if every prospectively fixed reachable historical case resolves to the exact bound blob and bytes or canonical digest, current and historical identities remain separate, the nonresolving control fails explicitly, and unchanged current validation accepts the valid control and rejects the malformed one. Otherwise record FAIL or NOT_EVALUABLE with the exact cause; no case replacement is allowed.

selection_reason: The completed synthetic representation audit left production-remote durability and nonresolving-commit behavior explicitly unknown. A bounded audit of already-public O history is materially different external-source evidence, is executable without replaying the synthetic measurement, and narrows those two uncertainties while the historical-reference Candidate remains inactive.
